craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Mother-reality per L3 note (against L2 principle — frozen); feminine she; beginningless end-weight; compound unsplit per BOUNDARY. Rejected: (a) mother-principle → killed by L3 note. (b) splitting long compound → killed: members listed, not split. Read aloud: THROUGH-link-ing a-LONE IS-she pro-CLAIMED … BE-gin-ning-LESS.

lines: Through linking alone is she proclaimed — of all awarenesses
the mother-reality, self-feeling's own name — beginningless.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekaiva cānusaṃdhānāt sā proktā sarvasaṃvidām svasaṃvedanaparyāyamātṛtattvam anādi tat
notes: line 2 nominal, mirroring verbless SA (proktā … anādi tat); mother-reality for mātṛtattva, against L2's mother-principle

reads_against.argmap: What is proclaimed through linking? → Proclamation: one linking mother-principle of all awarenesses, self-feeling itself, beginningless.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
